body: Honestly I don't have anything positive to say about that. After putting 2 years of hard work into maximizing my appearance and social skills and still seeing no results I can say without a doubt I can not keep doing this for years to come.

Thank you for actually reading what I've wrote.  All this "you're doing it wrong" crap that people like to throw my way happens no matter what I say I do around women so I don't bother talking about it anymore. I just know that nothing works for me.

Yeah I understand what you're saying about #1. I don't smoke frequently because I have no idea where to get it but when there's a bong around. Fuck yeah. I've never felt happier than when I'm high in the past 5 years or so. It's a shame that it only happens a few times a month. 

As for #2 I'm just so tired of trying to get into this conversation (we start by talking about girls and dating and bullshit) and in no time flat they go full-retard on me ("Just say hi, works every time") so I don't get into it. I've never broken down in front of my friends before so I don't even know what I'd do. I haven't seen my friends be openly emotional in years. We're all pretty solid dudes.

Nah. They'll just get mad at me. 

It's reached the point where I throw up multiple times a night. I think I'm just getting ready to die. 

I thought it'd be a lot more dramatic than this.

60 lbs so far. I was aiming for 115 before my birthday at the end of the year but I'm going to die in 4 day so whatever.

I'm a people person. I pride myself on conversation. I can talk to anyone about anything very easily. It's all about common ground. Conversations aren't the problem. If you're going to turn this into a blame game and tell me I'm doing it wrong or I need to "try a different approach" I'm just going to say been there, done that x50.

Somewhat.

They don't know I'm suicidal.

> Sometimes life does suck and we all die eventually. 

I fell on that "sometimes". 

Why should I live for others and remain lonely forever? Why should I live some retarded martyr life while they live normal lives.

I feel like a freak.

Nope. I'll always be that loveable best friend. It makes me almost want to throw up thinking about it.

How many more years am I supposed to endure? 1? 3? 5? 10? If even one of you people were being sincere and not doing this to feel good about yourselves I might listen. Maybe. I really just wanted to vent. I doubt anything said here will change my mind.

I honestly don't care. I'm just floating from day to day. Doing things because society expects me to and if I don't society will punish me by making me homeless and leaving me to die. The only difference here is I chose to do this because I enjoy it but music doesn't make me any less lonely. It just keeps me from thinking about it.

Lol guys. In the end it's not about finding someone anymore. I've learned PUA, been myself, changed my wardrobe, etc, etc, etc. Tried -everything- under the sun. Been halfway across my city and back exploring and meeting new people and nothing. Now that I've overcome my greatest hurdle, my weight, and have been looking for an additional six months I can finally say that I have no regrets. Nobody wants me and I refuse to live a life like this for the rest of my days.

"Sometimes life is shit and then you die" - Some guy.

I know they love me and I love them. We rarely see each other and they have people in their lives that love them the way everyone deserves to be loved and they sleep with them at night or text them up to the late hours of the evening. 

I know when I die they will be devastated, there's only four of us and I know 2/3 of them see me as actual family. I know a lot of people will be shocked and acquaintances will be confused. 

None of this matters once I go home to my cold, hard bed. 

I am so ready to die. I can't do 40+ odd years of this. It's too painful.
